missionPremise: X2 serialize half of the honesty contract (P-92 / A-052). DrawEdge.state is a one-inhabitant literal "present" at parcelDrawStub.ts:43 and the push site hardcodes it. 723 retired fixture edges ship because interpretBoundaryEdgeFactRows does not read body.status. sourceAdapter is on BoundaryEdgeFactPresent and on the gold atom body and is dropped before the draw wire. Serve-path only; do not mint; do not add adjacencyKind in {ROW, alley} => neighbour NULL (measured and refused).
completionPredicate: Done when (1) DrawEdge.state is a discriminated union present|unknown|refused the compiler enforces, not a one-inhabitant literal; (2) a fixture whose neighbour is refuted cannot emit present, and a gold shared-boundary edge marked reciprocal may stay present; (3) neighbor is always a key (string | null), never omitted; (4) a retired edge is absent from the served body and an active sibling is present; (5) sourceAdapter appears on every served DrawEdge; (6) tsc was shown to fail after the type widened and before the writer chose; (7) vitest both arms terminate; (8) this handback. Not done: commit, deploy, mint, X1 reciprocity instrument, MCP panel types, p2b-serve.
scopeBasis: Dispatch items 1-3. In scope: parcelDrawStub.ts, parcelDrawFromReads.ts, boundaryEdgeFactRead.ts, their tests. Out of scope by the card: neighbour-label repair, ROW/alley => neighbour NULL, writers (emit-boundary-edges-from-warm, boundary-primitive/compute), atom mint, P2b-serve tree, MCP iframe types, deploy.

design.DrawEdge: intersection of a required-field base (neighbor: string | null always; sourceAdapter: string | null always) with a discriminated union on state. present is a branch, not the type. unknown requires reason. refused requires reason and agentGuidance.
design.chooser: chooseDrawEdgeState(in). neighborClaim.refused => refused (id kept). neighborClaim.present and a neighbour id => present. else unknown (unverified or none found). No default present. Live fromReads does not invent a claim, so live ids serialize unknown until X1 feeds a claim.
design.goldPresentArm: parcelDrawStub gold edge 1 (34169) carries neighborClaim.state=present so the reciprocal arm is tested. Edge 2 (34121, ROW ray-cast) has no claim and must be unknown, not refused — the ROW invariant is not this card.
design.retiredFilter: interpretBoundaryEdgeFactRows drops body.status===retired before presentFromItems. assembleParcelDraw also skips status===retired so a caller who bypasses interpret cannot ship one. Missing status is not retired. All-retired => empty after filter => refuse ring.
design.sourceAdapter: parsed per edge in presentEdgeFromRow, mapped in parcelDrawFromReads, always emitted on DrawEdge.
design.tscEvidence: after widening, a type assertion DrawEdge['state'] extends 'present' is never; tsc fails; then the writer is completed and that assertion is not left in product code.

falsifiers.refutedEmitsPresent: a DrawBoundaryEdgeIn with neighborClaim.state=refused whose assembled edge.state==='present' — the check has failed
falsifiers.retiredShips: interpret of mixed active+retired includes the retired entityId, or assemble of a retired-only list emits that edge
falsifiers.neighborOmitted: an edge with no parcelNeighborPropId whose JSON lacks the neighbor key
falsifiers.rowInvariantCreepsIn: gold edge 2 (ROW + 34121) emits refused or neighbor null because of adjacencyKind
